name: GoMacro
description: Plant-based, organic nutrition bar brand (MacroBars) founded in Wisconsin. It runs its own Brand Ambassador Program: ambassadors get a custom code giving their audience 25% off gomacro.com, earn 10% commission on every purchase made with the code, receive a free tray of bars monthly, and are paid monthly through the Impact platform. Ambassadors must post at least once a month tagging @GoMacro.

evidence.summary: GoMacro's official Brand Ambassador Requirements page, fetched in full: ambassadors earn 10% commission on purchases made with their custom code (25% off for the audience), receive one free tray of MacroBars monthly, and 'Payments are made through the Impact platform and are distributed monthly.' Ambassadors are expected to post at least once per month tagging @GoMacro with #gomacropartner. The page publishes the contact mia@gomacro.com for event/partnership outreach. No earnings-cap statement and no creator count are published, so cap and saturation stay unknown.

GoMacro's official Brand Ambassador page describes the program's pillars (earn commission, collect rewards, community, sneak peeks), a challenge/rewards structure run through a management platform, 6-monthly ambassador reviews, and the application contact ambassadors@gomacro.com.

opportunity.title: GoMacro Brand Ambassador Program — 10% commission via custom code, paid monthly through Impact, free product monthly

reasons.niche_fit: Organic plant-based bars are core food/wellness creator content, and the brand brief explicitly spans Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and Facebook.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A structured ambassador program with monthly posting requirements, branded hashtags, challenges and rewards — built for recurring UGC.
reasons.compensation: 10% commission is mid-band for food; the 25%-off audience code and free monthly product add value, but no cap statement is published.
reasons.contact_access: Two published brand emails (ambassadors@ and a named partnerships contact) plus an open application page.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Applications are open on the brand's own site now; ambassadors are reviewed every six months rather than the program being closed.
reasons.credibility: Long-established national bar brand sold across US grocery; program terms are published on its own domain.

name: Lemme
description: Botanical gummy vitamin and supplement brand co-founded by Kourtney Kardashian Barker (Lemme Debloat, Purr, Glow). Its Ambassador and Affiliate Program runs primarily through the Impact network and TikTok Shop; reported commission is 10%-20% per sale. Lemme's TikTok Shop affiliate engine is one of the largest in wellness — reported at more than 13,000 commission-paid creators producing 53,000+ videos in a single quarter — so saturation is high even though entry is open.

evidence.summary: AffiliList's Lemme program profile, fetched in full: the Lemme Ambassador and Affiliate Program 'primarily operates through the Impact network and TikTok Shop', with a dedicated tracking dashboard, ambassador gifting and early product access; the directory's program listing reports commission of 10%-20% per sale, paid monthly via PayPal or ACH. The recorded rate is the 10% floor of that reported range. No earnings-cap statement is published, so cap stays unknown.

Femfounded's Lemme case study reports the brand's TikTok Shop affiliate engine at more than 13,000 creators and 53,000+ videos in a single quarter, driving $13M through TikTok Shop in November 2025, with commission-only affiliate links as the core model. That absolute creator count (13,000+) is the basis for the 'high' creator saturation rating.

opportunity.title: Lemme Ambassador & Affiliate Program — 10%-20% reported via Impact and TikTok Shop; 13,000+ creators already in (high saturation)

reasons.niche_fit: Gummy vitamins for debloat, sleep, focus and beauty are peak wellness-creator content with proven TikTok demand.
reasons.ugc_evidence: 53,000+ affiliate videos in a quarter is the strongest UGC evidence in this group — the whole growth model is creator content.
reasons.compensation: Reported 10%-20% per sale is top-band for supplements; the recorded 10 is the published floor of the range, and no cap statement is published.
reasons.contact_access: No public creator email was found on the fetched pages; entry is via Impact/TikTok Shop dashboards only.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open enrollment through TikTok Shop and Impact, but a new creator competes with 13,000+ existing affiliates.
reasons.credibility: Celebrity-founded brand with national retail (Target, Walmart, Erewhon) and verified nine-figure-scale sales reporting.

name: Supersmart

Its affiliate program runs on CJ Affiliate (tiered 10% base, rising to 11%/12%/13% at $1,000/$2,000/$5,000 in sales) and Webgains (fixed 11%) — all stated on the brand's own official FAQ page. Free to join with no minimum sales requirement.

evidence.summary: Supersmart's official affiliate FAQ, fetched in full: 'Supersmart's CJ Affiliate Program provides commissions that begin at 10%' with performance tiers of 11% at $1,000+ sales, 12% at $2,000+ and 13% at $5,000+; the Webgains program pays a fixed 11%. Registration is free, there is no minimum sales amount, and affiliates apply by searching 'SuperSmart' inside CJ Affiliate or Webgains. The FAQ answers the commission-rate question but publishes no earnings-cap statement and no creator count, so cap and saturation stay unknown. The recorded route is CJ Affiliate at the 10% base rate.

opportunity.title: Supersmart Affiliate Program on CJ — 10% base commission tiering to 13%, free to join, terms on the brand's own FAQ

reasons.niche_fit: A broad supplement catalogue gives health creators many angles, though the brand is less social-first than DTC peers.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Classic link/banner affiliate structure rather than a creator-content program; UGC evidence is the weakest in this group.
reasons.compensation: 10% base verified on the brand's own FAQ, tiering to 13% on CJ and a fixed 11% alternative on Webgains; no cap statement published.
reasons.contact_access: Clear application route inside CJ/Webgains plus a contact link on the official FAQ page.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Free to join with no minimum sales requirement, per the brand's own FAQ — open now.
reasons.credibility: Operating since 1992 with terms published on its own domain; a point held back for limited creator-program presence.
